meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 新用户首次与 omo 对话时,Claude 当向导,按顺序走六条线:功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值测算、记忆记录和首次 init-deep 提议,其中三条需你同意才做。产出一份迁移方案、基于本地会话日志的缓存节省估算,并把你的偏好写入 memory。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用 omo 时触发;它只会自动启动一次,之后可用 omo --onboard 或 senpi --onboard 手动唤回。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我过一遍。
say.note: 进入六条线的引导流程

say.text: 我原来用 Claude Code,帮我把配置迁过来。
say.note: 先给迁移方案,你确认后才应用

say.text: 翻一下我以前的编码会话,估一下能省多少。
say.note: 读取本地会话日志并给出估算

howto.what_en: On a new user's first omo conversation, Claude guides them through six lanes in order: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and a first-session init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; users can bring it back later with the omo --onboard or senpi --onboard flag.

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo — walk me through it.
I'm coming from Claude Code; carry my setup over.
say_en.note: Shows a migration plan, then waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Look through my past coding sessions and estimate the savings.
say_en.note: Reads local session logs and returns an estimate.
